purpose: At the exact descriptor-correlated dungeon root event, capture the read-only raw owner+0x10 value and best-effort target module identity; expose this in live status and the overlay.
measured_facts: Capture code reads 8 bytes once at owner+0x10 only after an exact descriptor-correlated root event is identified.
The value and target identity are persisted in the root event and live-status generation_rooms summary.
The code does not write NMS process memory.
inferences: The loaded-module base/RVA is an address classification only; the target semantic type is not established.
hypotheses: The slot may be relevant to the runtime dispatch investigation; runtime evidence is required to establish its role.

steps: Extract the Runtime-A 0.3.34 complete source/build over the existing Surveyor project/mod directory and keep current data/settings.
Open Surveyor and use Start NMS to load the updated probe.
Load the same known derelict and wait for +0x10 captured in the overlay.
Click Analyze generation + upload in Surveyor.
Verify the runtime-dispatch upload receipt, then return to Main and write check.
human_action.success_condition: Overlay reports ROOT+0x10 captured with value and target address/RVA identity; evidence upload receipt succeeds.

verification.compile: python -m compileall -q tools overlay tests mod — passed
verification.json: live-status schema and extension index parsed — passed

rollback: Restore the previous mod/derelict_baseline_probe.py (probe 0.3.33) and fully restart NMS.
